composition_label: Knowledge-base answers -> Guided setup -> Document review

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in this isolated build directory.

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version, synthetic=true, query, knowledge_base[], setup[], requirements[], documents[], evidence[].

entities.knowledge_base: id, text, match_terms[] (lowercase ASCII tokens), step_ids[]
entities.setup: id, title, prerequisites[] (step IDs), completed (boolean), requirement_ids[]
entities.evidence: id, requirement_id, document_id, quote, start (zero-based Python character offset)

shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic, status (complete or needs_attention), stages {faq, guided, review}; errors have schema_version, status=error and error {type, message}.
shared_schema.stage_packet: status (complete, abstained or skipped), article_ids[], step_ids[], requirement_ids[], data{}
shared_schema.validation: Shared shape, scalar, list, reference and packet validators. Strict keys; unique IDs/references; acyclic prerequisites; consistent completion; exact evidence quotes at offsets. Consumers validate packet grounding and scope. Duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numbers are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Grounding article, exact answer, selected step IDs and directly selected requirement IDs.
cross_stage_handoffs.rule: A unique lexical match produces the exact KB text. Guided validates article scope, then expands prerequisites in dependency-first order. Abstention skips downstream work.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Grounding article, dependency-expanded step IDs, progress, blocked/ready/completed state and deduplicated requirements.
cross_stage_handoffs.rule: Review validates guided state against trusted input and checks only propagated requirements. Incomplete setup becomes traceable review gaps.

behavior.faq: All configured match terms must be present as whole query tokens, case-insensitively. Zero or multiple matching articles cause explicit abstention.
behavior.guided: Completion is supplied by the fixture, never inferred. A step is ready only when its direct prerequisites are completed. Contradictory completion is an input error.
behavior.review: All required tokens must appear within one validated exact quote. Missing and insufficient evidence remain separate gaps. Evidence records include document IDs, quote text and character ranges. Gaps link requirements to selected steps and the grounding article.
behavior.exit_codes: 0 for valid execution, including abstention and gaps; 2 for file, decoding, JSON or validation errors. Stdout contains one JSON object.
behavior.limitations: Literal token matching does not establish semantic truth, detect negation, or certify compliance. Every review includes a non-certification disclaimer.
behavior.example: Explicitly synthetic seller-payout setup; one of two steps completed, account evidence present, payout evidence absent.

included: Shared input and output schema and validation layer
Traceable evidence checks and setup/document gaps
Synthetic fixtures and standard-library unittest coverage
excluded: Live LLM providers or network access
Semantic inference, embeddings or document parsing
Persistent databases, interactive setup changes or external side effects

example_cli.verified_behavior: Grounded FAQ, expanded setup prerequisites, 50% progress, account evidence match, incomplete setup and missing payout evidence gaps.
